races.verify_notes: Dug into this specifically as requested. Two problems found: (1) the candidate-level source_url cited for Marté (bsquarebulletin's 'monroe-county-sheriff-candidate-ruben-marte') is actually 2022 election coverage -- Marté vs. Hale/Purdie/Stalcup/Thomas in the 2022 D primary, with Nathan Williamson unopposed on the R side that cycle -- not 2026 coverage; it does not itself support the 2026 race and should be re-sourced. (2) Independently re-read the GOP-chair article (already cited, so not a new source, but content-checked directly): it confirms recruitment is underway but names no candidate, so the 'UNVERIFIED: Republican Candidate' placeholder and the contested:true flag remain unconfirmed by any source found. Indiana allows a county party to caucus-select a candidate when no one files in the primary, so a named R nominee may still emerge before ballot certification, but as of this pass none exists in the record. Recommend keeping this UNVERIFIED and re-sourcing the Marté citation.
